name: BE-29 blaster rifle
description: The BE-29 blaster rifle was a blaster rifle with a black barrel, a black scope, a black trigger, and a brown, petrified rochiawood shoulder stock. The moisture farmer Beru Whitesun Lars owned a sawed off BE-29 blaster rifle that acted as a shotgun blaster that she kept hidden behind a false pipe in the homestead she lived in with her husband Owen Lars and their adopted son, Luke Skywalker.
